name: Human Release Control
purpose: Require explicit, attributable human authorization before production promotion.
binding_rule: Approval is valid only for the exact candidate version, scope and intended environment stated in the approval record.
release_rule: Production promotion is blocked unless all applicable critical gates are PASS and an explicit human approval record is preserved and bound to the release candidate.
revocation_rule: A release approval becomes invalid if the candidate version, scope, policy, authority, connector identity or other approval-bearing parameter changes.
status_note: Implementation of this contract is not evidence of an actual production approval.
